bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a Center for Nursing Equity and Excellence at the University of Minnesota.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; UNIVERSITY OF MINNESOTA, THE CENTER FOR NURSING EQUITY AND EXCELLENCE. +]

[+$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to establish, in collaboration with Minnesota State Colleges and Universities, a Center for Nursing Equity and Excellence to address nursing workforce needs, including pathways into nursing education, innovations in nursing education, simulation in nursing, nursing workforce equality across all regions of Minnesota, and the well-being and flourishing of student nurses and nurses in clinical and academic practice. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a Center for Nursing Equity and Excellence at the University of Minnesota.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; UNIVERSITY OF MINNESOTA, THE CENTER FOR NURSING EQUITY AND EXCELLENCE.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to establish, in collaboration with Minnesota State Colleges and Universities, a Center for Nursing Equity and Excellence to address nursing workforce needs, including pathways into nursing education, innovations in nursing education, simulation in nursing, nursing workforce equality across all regions of Minnesota, and the well-being and flourishing of student nurses and nurses in clinical and academic practice.
additions: APPROPRIATION; UNIVERSITY OF MINNESOTA, THE CENTER FOR NURSING EQUITY AND EXCELLENCE.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to establish, in collaboration with Minnesota State Colleges and Universities, a Center for Nursing Equity and Excellence to address nursing workforce needs, including pathways into nursing education, innovations in nursing education, simulation in nursing, nursing workforce equality across all regions of Minnesota, and the well-being and flourishing of student nurses and nurses in clinical and academic practice.
